title: KLM — Knowledge Layers Model: specification and klm-conformance toolchain
description: KLM is a vendor-neutral reference model for attestable knowledge in language-model systems. This record archives the specification text (v0.3), the JSON schemas, the conformance vectors and the stdlib-only reference verifier klm-conformance. Tooling release 0.3.1 adds citation metadata and a --version flag; verdicts are identical to 0.3.0.
